usage: The phrase '我好攰' is used to express that you are very tired.
It can be used to describe physical or mental fatigue.
You can say it after a long day at work or after exercising.
It is a casual way to share your feeling of tiredness with friends or family.
You can add intensity by changing '好' to other adverbs like '好攰' (very tired) or '好攰到' (extremely tired).
